summary: TOMI Environmental Solutions (TOMZ) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a merger agreement to acquire Carbonium Core, Inc. via a merger sub. Consideration comprises TOMZ common stock (19.99% of outstanding pre-close) and Series C preferred stock that, upon conversion, gives Carbonium holders at least 90% of TOMZ capital stock on a fully converted basis, effectively a reverse merger. No cash price per share is disclosed. The board has not yet recommended; shareholder approval is required post-closing for conversion and name change. The deal is a stock-for-stock acquisition with significant dilution risk for TOMZ existing shareholders. Watch for Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635 shareholder vote and regulatory timing.
